messages.subject: R1041 report complete
messages.body: I reviewed the required indexed metadata and wrote the bounded source-backed epilogue comparison to the requested report. It finds same-subgroup fusion feasible only with an explicit accumulator owner map; same-workgroup local-memory/barrier and grouped-M designs are alternatives, while cross-workgroup reduction requires another kernel or a changed tile. The oneMKL-plus-reduction route remains the measured baseline, and a native build/runtime/performance qualification is still required.
